title: The Flying House of Loreto

tellings.quote: they would see things they thought were flying houses okay the Flying House of Laredo

plain: People in the past saw things in the sky that they took to be flying houses, and one example is the Flying House of Loreto in Italy. The researcher Diana Pasulka mentions it on the show, without naming a source, while discussing religious accounts. She uses it to suggest that older religious stories may describe the same kind of thing people now call UFOs.
